svg.title: Harsh Agarwal at a glance
svg.desc: Now: DevSecOps & Cloud Engineer at Hansa Solutions India Pvt Ltd, 2 yrs 7 mos since March 2024. Building ai-terraform-drift-detector Level 2. Education: B.Tech CSE, DIT University (2024), CGPA 8.56/10. Open to: Platform Engineering, Cloud Architecture, DevSecOps, DevOps Engineer, Infra Management. Primary cloud: Microsoft Azure (network: Hub-and-spoke · Firewall; security: Defender · Entra ID · PIM; govern: Landing zones · Policy). Platform: Landing Zones, Hub-and-spoke, Entra ID, Azure Policy, PIM. IaC: Terraform, Bicep, cloud-init. Pipelines: GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, OIDC federation, SHA-pinned actions. Security: TFLint, Trivy, Checkov, Gitleaks, TruffleHog, Defender for Cloud. FinOps: Infracost, Retail Prices API, Rightsizing, Reservations. AIOps: Python, LangGraph, MCP servers, RAG agents, Claude Code management.
